title: 第1章 开局激活系统杨过拜师第2章 命运商店开启
lines: 江寒此刻浑身冷飕飕的。
“我这是死了吧……”
之所以如此肯定，是因为江寒记得，自己所在的孤儿院夜晚着了大火。
他奋不顾身冲进去救人，五进五出，最后力气耗竭倒在了逃出来前最后的路上。
【宿主挽救数人生命，身怀大功德，天道有感念其功德，特将你投身到综武世界，继续挽救孤儿，改变他们的命运】
【叮~恭喜你激活“孤儿院系统”，每收一名孤儿，宿主即可获得该角色全盛巅峰期三项武学，并直接掌握。改变孤儿命运，可获得改命点，帮助他们脱离原有悲惨命运】
就在江寒愣神之际，脑海中突然迸出一道声音，同时眼帘前也出现了一个“孤儿院系统”的光幕。
“原来我没有死……而是被投放到综武世界了。”
江寒脑海中突然多了大量有关这个世界的内容。
这个综武世界，有南明、中唐、蒙元、北宋，更有西域、大理、西夏、后金，诸国并立。
江湖上实力分为三流、二流、一流、顶尖、宗师、超绝。
顶尖乃是后天大成境界。
想要成为宗师，需凝聚后天真气而转先天，先天真气生生不息，方为先天宗师境。
超绝，则是在精气神、入微、势中走出自己“道”的人。
找到属于自己的武道，以武道而接天道，感悟天道，便是超绝。
所以超绝也被称之为半步破碎境，亦或是半步金刚境。
除此之外，江湖上还设立了三个榜单，分别是天榜、地榜以及黑榜三大榜单。
天榜记录了正派十大超绝高手，地榜则是记录江湖新晋的十位青年才俊，黑榜记录的是黑道邪派的十位超绝高手。
榜单半月更新一次，由江湖杂志“半月谈”更新发出，上面会根据江湖上近来发生的大事和战斗，更新排名和战绩。
至于国家格局。
南明、中唐以及北宋三国结盟，共抗四周敌。
北宋的主要敌人是蒙元，中唐的敌人是西域、西夏诸国，南明抵抗后金。
知晓了时代背景，江寒现在只想知道，自己所在何处。
从地上爬起来，江寒不由紧了紧衣服，看到自己身处宽阔山顶，旁还有一块齐高石碑，上面写着“独孤峰”。山顶有石洞、茅屋。
将整个山顶逛了一圈，格局和环境俱是一流。
尤其是石洞内，曲径通幽、别有洞天，有数间石室。
自己是孤儿，激活了孤儿院系统，这山又叫“独孤峰”。
不出意外，这里就是日后“开宗立派”的落脚点了。
江寒看着山顶云海，云卷云舒，心情不由开阔，感叹道：“还是得先搞清楚这里是哪里比较好。”
知道了地点，才能继续下一步计划不是？
确定穿越了综武世界，江寒一个手无缚鸡之力的普通人，首先要做的就是收一位孤儿角色，学会其原本命运巅峰期的三项武功绝学傍身。
也只有确定了自己的所在，才能进行下一步计划。
content_en:
Jiang Han felt chilly all over at this moment.
"I must be dead..."
The reason why he was so sure was because Jiang Han remembered that the orphanage where he was was on fire at night.
He rushed in to save people regardless of his own safety, and went in and out five times. Finally, he was exhausted and fell on the last road before escaping.
[The host has saved the lives of several people and has great merits. Heaven is grateful for his merits and specially throws you into the world of mixed martial arts to continue to save orphans and change their destiny]
[Ding~ Congratulations on activating the "Orphanage System". Every time you take in an orphan, the host can obtain the three martial arts at the peak of the character's heyday and directly master it. Change the fate of orphans and you can get life-changing points to help them escape from their original tragic fate]
Just when Jiang Han was stunned, a voice suddenly burst out in his mind, and at the same time, a light curtain of the "Orphanage System" appeared in front of his eyes.
"It turns out that I didn't die...but was thrown into the world of mixed martial arts."
Jiang Han suddenly had a lot of content about this world in his mind.
In this world of comprehensive martial arts, there are the Southern Ming Dynasty, the Middle Tang Dynasty, the Mongolian Yuan Dynasty, the Northern Song Dynasty, as well as the Western Regions, Dali, Xixia, and the Later Jin Dynasty, all countries coexisting side by side.
Strength in the arena is divided into third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, top, master, and transcendent.
The pinnacle is the state of acquired perfection.
If you want to become a grandmaster, you need to gather the posterior true energy and turn it into the innate. Only by condensing the innate true energy will you be able to achieve the state of innate master.
Transcendence is a person who walks out of his own "Tao" in spirit, subtlety and momentum.
Find your own martial arts, use martial arts to connect with the way of heaven, and understand the way of heaven, that is transcendence.
Therefore, transcendence is also called the half-step broken state, or the half-step vajra state.
In addition, there are three lists in Jianghu, namely the Heavenly List, the Earthly List and the Black List.
The Heavenly List records the ten supreme masters of the decent sects, the Earthly Ranking records the ten young talents who are newly promoted in the world, and the Black List records the ten supreme masters of the underworld and evil sects.
The list is updated every half month, and is updated by Jianghu magazine "Half Moon Talk". The rankings and achievements will be updated based on recent major events and battles in Jianghu.
As for the national structure.
The three kingdoms of the Southern Ming Dynasty, the Middle Tang Dynasty and the Northern Song Dynasty formed an alliance to fight against the surrounding enemies.
The main enemy of the Northern Song Dynasty was the Mongolian Yuan Dynasty, the enemies of the Middle Tang Dynasty were the Western Regions and the Western Xia Kingdoms, and the Southern Ming Dynasty resisted the Later Jin Dynasty.
Knowing the background of the times, Jiang Han now just wants to know where he is.
Getting up from the ground, Jiang Han couldn't help but tighten his clothes and saw that he was on the top of a broad mountain. There was a tall stone tablet next to it with "Dugu Peak" written on it. There are caves and huts on the top of the mountain.
After walking around the entire mountain top, the layout and environment are first-class.
Especially inside the stone cave, there are winding paths, unique caves, and several stone chambers.
He is an orphan and has activated the orphanage system. This mountain is also called "Dugu Peak".
Not surprisingly, this would be the starting point for “establishing a sect” in the future.
Jiang Han looked at the sea of clouds on the top of the mountain, and the clouds rolled and relaxed. He couldn't help but feel relaxed, and sighed: "It's better to find out where this is first."
Only when you know the location can you proceed with your next plan, right?
After confirming that he has traveled through the world of mixed martial arts, Jiang Han, an ordinary person with no strength, the first thing he has to do is to take in an orphan character and learn the three martial arts secrets that he used at the peak of his destiny.
Only when you have determined where you are can you make the next plan.
title_en: Chapter 1 Activating the System at the Start and Yang Guo’s Apprenticeship Chapter 2 The Destiny Store Opens
